description: POST action=create_order — payment_method='cod' -> status jumps straight to 'confirmed' (COD skips the 'awaiting payment' step) AND `transactions.wms_status` is set to 'pending_pick' inside the same transaction (L1582-1590). payment_status is STILL 'pending' (never 'paid' at creation time, regardless of payment method — the acceptance criteria's non-negotiable point). shipping_fee=0 here because the tenant's shop_settings row has shipping_fee=0 (a flat-rate-free-shipping tenant), independent of the free_shipping_min comparison. total = subtotal (100) + shipping_fee (0) = 100.
